answer: A numbered permafrost core drilled from the tundra at an oasis edge is the proof. At dawn the holder drills one core and the keeper photographs its marble-white ice bands with the date. Two verifiers return within 24 hours, drill a second core beside it, and match the bands and core number; a core never drilled there or a duplicate number locks and burns the deposit. 100 fakes need 100 drill trips and 100 core tubes.
